description: This file defines the WrappedHttpHandler class which adapts an HTTP handler into an AWS-specific command handler, handling request responses and errors, and integrating with the AWS SDK and PSR-7 interfaces.

classes.name: WrappedHttpHandler
classes.description: A class that wraps a generic HTTP handler to conform to AWS SDK's command and response handling, managing response parsing and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the handler with HTTP handler, response parsers, exception class, and stats collection flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped HTTP handler with a command and request, returning a promise that resolves to an AWS response or error.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response into an AWS result, attaching metadata such as status code, headers, and transfer stats.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Converts an error rejection into an AWS exception, parsing error details from the response when available.
